title: ExpeditionCraft
description: the best experience for playing on expeditioncraft
body:
## 🌍 ExpeditionCraft Client

**ExpeditionCraft Client** enhances your gameplay experience with a minimalist yet useful HUD and an optimized screenshot system.

## ✨ Features

### 🧭 Area HUD
- Displays important information about your current surroundings  
- Can be toggled on and off at any time  
- Default key: **H**

### 📸 Improved Screenshot System
- Replaces Minecraft’s default F2 function  
- Custom screenshot logic for better control and extensibility  
- Default key: **F2**

## ⚙️ Technical Details

- Developed for **Fabric**  
- Uses:
  - Fabric Keybinding API  
  - Client Tick Events  
- Lightweight and fully client-side
